title: Good Food, Oaths, and Staying Away from Wrong

paragraphs.text: They hope to enter Paradise with the righteous. Allah rewards them with gardens and rivers. Those who deny His signs go to Hellfire.

Do not forbid good things that Allah made lawful. Eat what is good and lawful. If you break a serious oath, there is a payment. Feed ten poor people, or clothe them, or free a slave. If you cannot, fast for three days. Intoxicants and gambling are from Satan. They bring hatred and turn you from prayer. So stay away from them. Obey Allah and the Messenger.
Do not hunt land animals in the state of ihram. Food from the sea is lawful for you. Allah made the Ka'bah, the Sacred House, a support for people. He knows all in the heavens and the earth.
Allah is severe in penalty, yet Forgiving and Merciful. Evil and good are not equal, even if evil is more.
